description: Talk to The Leos' own agent in plain language, the way a client would: describe the project, ask anything (the work, starting prices, the studio for rent and its kit, the team), and name a call time in words, with the client's email, to book it (a calendar invite with a video link goes to that email). It answers in the studio's voice, one short line, and returns the brief so far, open call times when it offers them, a starting price, the closest work and the brief's page. Pass conversation_id from the last reply to continue. When the brief is confirmed it goes to the studio, and a person replies within one working day.

conversation_id.description: from the previous reply, to continue the same brief

message.description: what the client says, in English or Italian

name: talk_to_the_studio
